title: KYC keeps failing
text: KYC verification keeps failing after I upload the same document again. The app does not explain what is wrong.

title: Easy mutual fund tracking
text: The portfolio view is simple and I can see my mutual funds in one place.

title: UPI payment stuck
text: My SIP payment showed pending for hours and I could not tell whether it would retry.

title: Statements are hard to find
text: I wanted a capital gains statement but the menu path was not obvious.

title: Login issue
text: The app logged me out and the OTP screen kept loading.

title: Good dashboard
text: Dashboard is clean and holdings refresh quickly most days.

title: Withdrawal delay
text: The withdrawal status did not update clearly after I placed a redemption request.

title: Need clearer support
text: Support replied but I had to repeat the same issue twice.

title: Payment failure
text: Money got debited but the app still showed payment failed for the order.

title: Can not download report
text: Tax report download failed twice and there was no clear error message.

title: Useful app
text: I like the way stocks and mutual funds are shown together.

title: Onboarding confusing
text: Account setup asks for many steps and I was not sure which one was pending.

title: KYC pending
text: KYC has been pending for several days and the status message is generic.

title: Statement download
text: Capital gains report should be easier to access before tax filing.

title: App slow after update
text: After the latest update the portfolio screen takes too long to load.

title: Helpful overview
text: It gives a useful snapshot of my investments without opening multiple apps.

title: SIP issue
text: SIP setup failed at payment confirmation and I could not find next steps.

title: Support wait time
text: The chat support queue took longer than expected for a payment issue.
